header.name: Earth (planet view) V13
header.description: Earth on its own, increment 13 of 20. Shaded continents, deserts and ice from a rough map; a noise cloud shell that drifts; a station, launches, storms, aurora, a constellation of small satellites, city lights and craters on the Moon. Sizes are rough; not to scale.
